paragraphs: AIB is a big bank in Ireland. Its boss, Colin Hunt, spoke at a big United Nations meeting about the climate. The meeting is called COP31. It is in Antalya, in Turkey.
Hunt said AIB wants to lend 60 billion euro for green projects by 2030. This is two times its old goal of 30 billion euro.
Since 2019, the bank has lent 28 billion euro for green projects. Last year, 43% of its new loans were green. Many people got green mortgages for homes that use little energy.
Hunt said banks must help. They can pay for clean energy like wind and sun power. They can help families make their homes warmer and cheaper to heat.
But at the meeting, some big countries do not want strong new goals. They still want to use oil, gas and coal.
sentZh: AIB是愛爾蘭的一家大銀行。
它的老闆柯林·亨特在一場關於氣候的聯合國大型會議上發言。
這場會議叫做COP31。
會議在土耳其的安塔利亞舉行。
亨特說，AIB希望在2030年前為綠色計畫放款600億歐元。
這是它原本300億歐元目標的兩倍。
自2019年以來，這家銀行已為綠色計畫放款280億歐元。
去年，它的新貸款中有43%是綠色貸款。
許多人為耗能很少的房子申請了綠色房貸。
亨特說，銀行必須出一份力。
它們可以出錢支持風力、太陽能這類乾淨能源。
它們可以幫助家庭讓住家更溫暖、暖氣更省錢。
但在會議上，一些大國不想要嚴格的新目標。
它們仍然想使用石油、天然氣和煤。

paragraphs: AIB, one of Ireland's biggest banks, has doubled its target for green lending. Chief executive Colin Hunt made the announcement on 13 November at COP31, the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Turkey. The bank now plans to lend 60 billion euro for green and transition projects by 2030.

The old target was 30 billion euro, and AIB has almost reached it. Since 2019, it has lent 28 billion euro, or 93% of the goal. In 2025, green loans made up 43% of all its new lending, at 6.3 billion euro. In the first nine months of 2026, it lent another 5.3 billion euro.
Hunt said banks have a very important job. They can pay for renewable energy, help families make their homes use less energy, and support businesses as they change.

The bank's climate capital business pays for large renewable energy and infrastructure projects in Ireland, Britain, Europe and North America. It has grown faster than any other part of AIB. Also, nearly 60% of its mortgages last year were green mortgages, for homes with high energy ratings.
However, the summit is not going smoothly. Observers say some big producers and users of fossil fuels are fighting against firm new targets.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭最大銀行之一AIB已將綠色放款目標加倍。
執行長柯林·亨特於11月13日在土耳其安塔利亞舉行的聯合國氣候峰會COP31上宣布此事。
這家銀行現在計劃在2030年前為綠色與轉型計畫放款600億歐元。
原本的目標是300億歐元，而AIB幾乎已經達成。
自2019年以來，它已放款280億歐元，也就是目標的93%。
2025年，綠色貸款達63億歐元，占其所有新放款的43%。
2026年前九個月，它又放款了53億歐元。
亨特說，銀行肩負非常重要的任務。
它們可以資助再生能源，幫助家庭讓住家更節能，並在企業轉變時給予支持。
這家銀行的氣候資本業務資助愛爾蘭、英國、歐洲和北美的大型再生能源及基礎建設計畫。
它的成長速度比AIB任何其他部門都快。
此外，去年它近60%的房貸是綠色房貸，提供給能源評級高的住宅。
不過，這場峰會進行得並不順利。
觀察人士說，一些化石燃料的大生產國和大使用國正在反對明確的新目標。

paragraphs: AIB has doubled its green and transition lending target to 60 billion euro by 2030, chief executive Colin Hunt announced at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, on 13 November. The move comes as the bank nears its existing goal well ahead of schedule.

Since 2019, AIB has provided 28 billion euro in green and transition loans, representing 93% of its current 30 billion euro target. Such lending reached 6.3 billion euro in 2025, accounting for 43% of all new loans, and the bank added a further 5.3 billion euro in the first nine months of this year.

Hunt argued that banks play a critical role in the shift to a low-carbon economy. They finance renewable energy, help households improve the energy efficiency of their homes, and support businesses through the transition.

AIB's climate capital division, which funds large renewable and infrastructure projects in Ireland, Britain, Europe and North America, has been its fastest-growing business in recent years. Meanwhile, almost 60% of its mortgage lending last year consisted of green mortgages, issued for homes with strong energy ratings.

The announcement contrasts with the mood at the summit, where observers say major fossil-fuel producers and consumers are resisting firm new targets or any commitment to move away from oil, gas and coal.

此舉之際，這家銀行正遠早於預定時程接近其現有目標。
自2019年以來，AIB已提供280億歐元的綠色與轉型貸款，相當於其現行300億歐元目標的93%。
這類放款在2025年達到63億歐元，占所有新貸款的43%，而今年前九個月該行又增加了53億歐元。
亨特主張，銀行在轉向低碳經濟的過程中扮演關鍵角色。
它們資助再生能源，協助家庭提升住宅的能源效率，並支持企業度過轉型期。
AIB的氣候資本部門資助愛爾蘭、英國、歐洲和北美的大型再生能源與基礎建設計畫，近年來一直是其成長最快的業務。
同時，該行去年近60%的房貸是綠色房貸，核發給能源評級優良的住宅。
這項宣布與峰會的氣氛形成對比；觀察人士說，主要的化石燃料生產國與消費國正抗拒明確的新目標，也不願承諾擺脫石油、天然氣和煤炭。

paragraphs: AIB has set its sights considerably higher on climate finance, doubling its 2030 target for green and transition lending to 60 billion euro. Chief executive Colin Hunt unveiled the revised goal at COP31, the UN climate summit being held in Antalya, Turkey.

The upgrade reflects how swiftly the bank has outpaced its original ambition. Since 2019, it has extended 28 billion euro in qualifying loans, some 93% of the existing 30 billion euro benchmark. Green and transition lending amounted to 6.3 billion euro in 2025, or 43% of new business, with a further 5.3 billion euro advanced in the first nine months of 2026.

Hunt contended that lenders are pivotal to the transition, channelling capital into renewable energy, enabling householders to retrofit their homes and steering businesses through a period of profound change.

Much of the momentum stems from AIB's climate capital arm, which bankrolls large-scale renewable and infrastructure schemes across Ireland, Britain, continental Europe and North America and has been the group's fastest-expanding division. On the retail side, green mortgages for homes with top energy ratings accounted for almost 60% of last year's mortgage lending.

Yet the bank's upbeat message sits uneasily with the wider negotiations, where observers report that leading fossil-fuel producers and consumers are digging in their heels against firm new targets or any pledge to phase out oil, gas and coal.
sentZh: AIB在氣候金融上大幅提高了目標，將2030年綠色與轉型放款目標加倍至600億歐元。
執行長柯林·亨特在土耳其安塔利亞舉行的聯合國氣候峰會COP31上公布了修訂後的目標。
這次上調反映出該行超越原定目標的速度之快。
自2019年以來，它已發放280億歐元的合格貸款，約為現行300億歐元基準的93%。
2025年綠色與轉型放款達63億歐元，占新業務的43%；2026年前九個月又貸出53億歐元。
亨特主張，放款機構對轉型至關重要：將資金導入再生能源、讓屋主得以翻修住宅提升能效，並引導企業度過深刻變革的時期。
這股動能多半來自AIB的氣候資本部門，它出資支持愛爾蘭、英國、歐陸和北美的大型再生能源與基礎建設計畫，也是集團擴張最快的部門。
在零售業務方面，能源評級頂尖住宅的綠色房貸占去年房貸放款的近60%。
然而，該行樂觀的訊息與整體談判格格不入；觀察人士指出，主要化石燃料生產國與消費國正堅決抵制明確的新目標，也拒絕承諾逐步淘汰石油、天然氣和煤炭。

paragraphs: AIB has announced a substantial expansion of its climate finance commitments, doubling its 2030 target for green and transition lending to 60 billion euro. The announcement was made by chief executive Colin Hunt at COP31, the United Nations climate conference convened in Antalya, Turkey.

The revision is largely a consequence of the bank's rapid progress. Since 2019, AIB has issued 28 billion euro in eligible loans, equivalent to 93% of its previous 30 billion euro objective. In 2025 alone, such lending totalled 6.3 billion euro, constituting 43% of all new lending, while a further 5.3 billion euro was provided during the first nine months of 2026.

Hunt maintained that financial institutions fulfil an indispensable function in the energy transition: financing renewable generation, enabling households to enhance the energy efficiency of their homes, and assisting enterprises as they adapt.

A significant proportion of this growth is attributable to the bank's climate capital division, which finances large-scale renewable and infrastructure projects in Ireland, Britain, Europe and North America, and which has consequently become its fastest-growing unit. Furthermore, nearly 60% of last year's mortgage lending comprised green mortgages for properties with high energy ratings.

Nevertheless, the broader prospects for the summit remain uncertain. According to observers, major producers and consumers of fossil fuels are resisting firm new targets, and progress on moving away from oil, gas and coal appears contingent upon their cooperation.
